purpose: Model a race as a mixture of coherent finish-order worlds instead of one shared Plackett-Luce world. Preserve frozen L1.7 mean_probability as the NORMAL world and add KING1_COLLAPSE, OUTSIDER_RISE, and BOTH worlds. Evaluate probability quality only; no ticket selection, ROI optimization, or staking.

worlds.KING1_COLLAPSE: NORMAL with consensus-rank-1 latent strength multiplied by a prior-calibrated collapse factor.
worlds.OUTSIDER_RISE: NORMAL with safe Outsider-supported horses outside KING Top5 boosted by prior-calibrated support-weighted factor.
worlds.BOTH: Apply KING1_COLLAPSE and OUTSIDER_RISE transforms together.

mixture_weights.collapse_gate: Walk-forward LightGBM probability that KING rank1 misses official top3.
mixture_weights.outsider_gate: Walk-forward LightGBM probability that at least one safe-Outsider-supported horse outside KING Top5 reaches official top3.
mixture_weights.combination: Assume gate independence only for V2 weight composition: NORMAL=(1-qc)(1-qo), COLLAPSE=qc(1-qo), OUTSIDER=(1-qc)qo, BOTH=qc*qo.
mixture_weights.gate_features: Only frozen pre-race L1.7 diagnostics plus safe Outsider ballot aggregates; no odds, popularity, payout, or result features.

calibration.internal_split: Chronological 80/20 split inside each training fold.
calibration.gate_temperature: Choose broad temperature grid by binary log loss on internal calibration races.
calibration.selection_metric: Mean negative log probability of the official unordered top3 set (TRIO probability) on prior-only internal calibration races.
calibration.holdout_rule: Test year never participates in gate fitting, temperature selection, or scenario-parameter selection.

evaluation.primary: BASE_NORMAL versus MIXTURE probability quality by test year and bet type.

data_policy.odds_files: May be read only to enumerate historical offered ticket combinations; price values are ignored by V2.
